summary: The edition has 100 complete guides and 13 screened discoveries. It completes 23 earlier pending guides and details 7 substantive release updates. Today’s source reviews cover Kilnframe’s FilmCraft integration and Clio’s on-device FilmCraft and Whisper workflow on Android. Other guides span animated dialogue, editable stem and MIDI handoffs, and learned material capture. Models and OS requirements vary by workflow. Code grants were read in full. Models, services, creative inputs and hardware or software hosts have separate requirements. This edition is based on source review and published documentation. No discovered app was installed or run. The expanded plan covered 120 fields, 1378/1378 repository-query attempts and 37 model tasks. The repository lane recorded 1378 successful, 0 partial and 0 failed queries, with 254 bounded. The model lane recorded 0 failed tasks. Metadata from 2,864 saved repository pages included 84,512 numeric identities. The complete retained backlog spans 120,138 candidates, including pilot history and 1,080 previously screened guides still pending before this edition. Creative relevance and the complete software grant were checked before including any discovery. Unreviewed and excluded records stay in local research. Live primary research yielded 800 complete usable responses from 1022 distinct URL attempts, including a non-GitHub source in each of 120 fields. 14 captures reached the size bound and 208 other sources were inaccessible or unusable. The ecosystem checks cover all 8 configured groups and record available findings and gaps. Evidence labels in this edition are 0 Recommended, 0 Ready to try, 100 Quality unverified, 13 Experimental. Repository searches returned no saved rows for Camera-reactive projection installations, Live production accessibility and routed captions, Learned material capture and de-lighting, Learned projector compensation and exhibit color. Primary web research for these fields is included in the coverage notes. Updated evidence labels for previous entries: Hologram Parallax Photo Studio (Experimental to Quality unverified), Arm Compute Flow Bricks (Quality unverified to Experimental). 33 model tasks reached the configured response limit of 50 rows. A model record remains a discovery lead until code and use are verified. Model tasks with no rows: text2text-generation, zero-shot-audio-classification, audio-segmentation, image-matting. The separate watchlist made 67 unsuccessful repository checks. Collection logged 5 enrichment failures. Credential-shaped material in unsealed captures was removed before sealing. The affected source origins and before-and-after hashes remain in private evidence.
